name: aihelp-stack
description: 须 VPN。配置 ~/.aihelp-stack.env（chmod 600）。值不要带 Basic/Bearer/AccessKey 前缀。 1. AIHELP_MCP_HOST：MCP 网关主机或 IP，不要 http:// 和端口，向同事索取 2. AIHELP_MCP_BASIC：echo -n 'user:password' | base64，只填 Base64 3. AIHELP_GITLAB_MCP_TOKEN：GitLab → Preferences → Access Tokens，权限含 api 4. JUMPSERVER_MCP_ACCESSKEY：JumpServer API Key，填 id:secret 5. AIHELP_LANGFUSE_MCP_BASIC：Langfuse MCP 的 Base64(user:password)
